summary: postinstall fetches and executes native binary from hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook downloads a platform-specific tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, extracts it, chmods the contained binary to 0755, and links it as the package's runtime CLI. The fetch is performed with rejectUnauthorized: false (TLS certificate verification disabled) and no hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded payload. The download destination is a bare IPv4 address rather than a publisher-owned domain matching the @onescience scope, so the delivered bytes cannot be attributed to the package publisher, and any party in a network-position between the installer and 218.90.133.98 can substitute arbitrary native code that runs as the package's binary on subsequent invocations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
